question: Does recent FAA advisory activity improve airport-local weather forecasts across all 100 major U.S. airports in the current study?
scope: All 100 airports in the source protocol, including U.S. territories. Each airport learns only from its own reporting-carrier scheduled domestic outcomes. Medium/private airports without flight outcomes receive context, not transferred probabilities.
faaRule: Use the shared historical/live extractor. At a forecast cutoff, use publication timestamps no later than the preceding hourly collection at :35 minus 10 minutes. Count exact airport GS/GDP issue/revision/cancellation messages in the preceding 6/24 hours. Never use future effective starts, observations, flight outcomes, or volume as predictors. Full date coverage is required. A missing archive day is unknown. PBI is explicitly mapped to the current DJT outcome identifier.
sourceReuse: Reparse the 903 complete national FAA daily listings cached by operations-pilot-v1 for every airport. Preserve the 30 missing/ambiguous dates. No new historical downloads and no runway feature requirement.
learner: Fixed v3 airport-local regularized logistic heads, independent probability calibration and 80% empirical outcome-rate band calibration. All three variants share identical eligible rows within each airport/direction/horizon. Original production weather models are preserved separately.
primaryMetric: Paired flight-event-weighted disruption Brier error: operations versus matched weather baseline.
uncertainty: 1000 paired three-day calendar-block bootstrap draws. BH adjustment across all tested operations-versus-weather slices separately for each period. Aggregates share sampled calendar blocks across airports. Descriptive aggregate intervals are not multiplicity adjusted. Different horizons retain different eligible windows.
testDisclosure: Both 2026 periods and the six pilot airports were previously inspected. This is a retrospective nationwide expansion following an encouraging pilot, not a pristine confirmatory test. Do not tune on these outcomes or hide regressions.
serving: An explicitly experimental operations model may be compared with the existing weather model. Require local fit/calibration/test support, supported local hours, fresh complete FAA history, a complete fresh TAF window, and matching feature versions. Expose missing FAA history as unavailable, never silently zero. Evidence labels use the winter operations-versus-weather comparison and downgrade out-of-range inputs. Sparse or absent FAA messages are disclosed; no claim of private-jet accuracy or comprehensive congestion/ATC coverage.

budget.rule: Fit locally from existing cached data. Live shared national advisory collection is bounded and must fit existing compute, early-stop, lease, storage, and dollar safeguards. No browser-triggered provider requests or training.
